question: Ticket 4366edb56144 says 'outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only', but outline 6.6.3.7 reads "The hostname comes from the system device. It answers which box (the short hostname, lowercased) and which OS family, and nothing else in Cairn asks the OS for the hostname. Callers reach it through the client tool it publishes (2.3.7.1.5), so a box names itself on every OS, Windows included, with no bus running. - akiendelllinux_cc_0" (Outline 6.6.3.7 explicitly states: 'It answers which box (the short hostname, lowercased) and which OS family, and nothing else in Cairn asks the OS for the hostname.' The outline requires the system device to answer both the hostname AND OS family. The ticket claims in its bounds section that the outline only requires hostname, excluding OS-family checks from scope. These cannot both be true—the outline clearly includes OS family as part of what the system device must answer.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: Both stand; they do not conflict. Outline 6.6.3.7 has one exclusive clause, 'nothing else in Cairn asks the OS for the hostname', and that is exactly the call sites this ticket repoints. For OS family the outline says the system device answers it (6.6.3.7) and publishes it (2.3.7.1.5); it does: os_id() is in cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, built by 5ccc7f05c932. Neither line says no other code may test the OS family, so the 54 OS-family checks are outside both the outline's exclusivity and this ticket's claim, and repointing them would be a new intention, not this one's missing half. Read from the whys already in the outline, so CC's (outline 0.4.1).
